summary: Connect sensor, estimation and control components through an inspectable robotics software graph.
outcomes: Choose topics, services and actions for different interactions
Trace timestamps, transform frames, QoS and component lifecycle
sequence: Run a minimal local publisher and subscriber
Compare streams with request/reply and cancellable tasks
Inspect incompatible QoS and stale transforms
Record and replay a small integration trace

visual.question: Why can a running subscriber receive no useful data?
visual.interaction: Change topic type, QoS compatibility and transform availability independently

practice.task: Build a simulated sensor-to-state ROS graph
practice.success: Messages, frames, timestamps and lifecycle transitions are observed and failures are diagnosed
